about: Symmetrel (amantadine) 100 mg is supplied monthly from January to July 2026 beside levodopa, by brand name only.
Amantadine 100 mg capsules are supplied five times from December 2025 to April 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history that also holds levodopa.
Levodopa with carbidopa and rasagiline are supplied. No amantadine appears, so it must not flag.
